Select molecule ChEMBL ID, molecule name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in document CHEMBL1697781. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1697781. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID. Do not deduplicate.
